mechanism.rule: margin += (loss_away - loss_home) * possessions/100 ; total += -(1 - 2*alpha) * (loss_home + loss_away) * possessions/100

honest_limits: Impact is a LOWER BOUND: a listed player outside the captured top-50 minutes table contributes 0.00 net-rating points, so a team can be missing real rotation and still show 0.0. The count of such players is published per game below.

The 01:30 PM ET edition is the newest published when this was captured. Memphis had not filed; its game-day window (11 a.m. to 1 p.m. local, Central time, for an 8:00 PM ET tip) was still open at capture time, so 'not yet submitted' is not a missed deadline.

Status labels are the league's own words. The probability attached to each label (Out 1.00 / Doubtful 0.70 / Questionable 0.35 / Probable 0.10 / Available 0.00) is a modelling choice of this project, not an official figure, and is flagged as such (F4).
No market price exists anywhere in this file. 'Re-priced' means the model against its own naive reference, never the model against a book.
